name: Local DNS Sync
description: Pushes DHCP names into Pi-hole or AdGuard Home local DNS so hostnames like nas.lan resolve without Kea DDNS — Jen only ever touches records it created itself (a ledger), and an Unbound export is offered for setups with no API.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ds_targets (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, kind ENUM('pihole','adguard') NOT NULL, url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, credential TEXT, domain VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lan', sources SET('leases','reservations','ipam') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'leases,reservations', subnet_ids JSON NULL, allow_self_signed TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, previewed_at DATETIME NULL, last_sync_at DATETIME NULL, last_error VARCHAR(300) NULL, last_alert_at DATETIME NULL, created_by VARCHAR(100), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ds_records (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, target_id INT NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(63) NOT NULL, ip VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL, source ENUM('lease','reservation','ipam') NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE KEY ux_target_name (target_id, name))
